how_to_apply: Visit the official SJVN website: www.sjvn.nic.in
Go to the Career section and register with a valid, active email ID and mobile number.
Fill in all details in the online application form carefully, including qualification and experience details for each organization worked at.
Upload the required photograph and signature as per the specified format and size.
Pay the applicable application fee online (if not exempted).
Submit the online application before the closing date, i.e., 26/08/2026 (11:59 PM).

Take a printout of the submitted application (preview) and send it along with the payment receipt, experience details and supporting certificates to the address below, so as to reach on or before 15/09/2026:
Postal Address: Advt. No. 127/2026 O/o DGM (HR/Recruitment) SJVN Limited, Shakti Sadan, Corporate Head Quarters, Shanan, Shimla, Himachal Pradesh - 171006

Applications submitted online can be edited/updated until the last date of online submission; no changes are permitted after that date. Applications received in hard copy after the prescribed last date will be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: Candidates should apply online only; no other mode of submission is accepted. Only one application per post is allowed. Incomplete applications or applications without the requisite application fee will be rejected. Where posts are not reserved for a category, reserved-category candidates may also apply under the UR category if they meet the unreserved eligibility criteria. Candidates called for the Personal Interview will be reimbursed 2nd Class AC Sleeper Rail/Bus fare by the shortest route, as per SJVN rules. Persons working under Central/State Government or Public Sector Undertakings must produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview. Canvassing in any form will result in immediate disqualification. Candidates are advised to be cautious of fraudulent persons, agencies, or websites; SJVN does not seek any payment other than the application fee. All correspondence regarding the recruitment will be through the registered e-mail ID only. Any revision, clarification, addendum or corrigendum will be hosted only on the Career section of the SJVN website - no separate notification will be issued. Internal applicants have no upper age bar, and internal candidates with AMIE qualification in the respective discipline are also eligible. For queries, candidates may e-mail [email protected], mentioning "Advt. No. 127/2026 and Designation" in the subject line.

content_sections.heading: SJVN Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates from the SC/ST/PwBD categories must have scored 50% or more marks, while candidates in other categories need 55% or more marks in the essential qualification. Rounding off of percentage is not permitted; for example, 54.99% will not be considered as 55%. Minimum age for all posts is 18 years, and applicants must be Indian Nationals. Upper age limit inclusive of all relaxations shall not exceed 55 years. Age relaxation for PwBD candidates is applicable irrespective of whether the post is reserved for that category, provided the post is identified as suitable for PwBD. There is no upper age bar for internal applicants of SJVN. All posts require relevant post-qualification executive experience in Erection/Commissioning and/or Operation & Maintenance (O&M) of Coal-based Thermal Power Plants, including specific experience in Super Critical Thermal Power Plants of minimum 660 MW capacity. SC/ST candidates get a relaxation of one year in total experience where the requirement is more than three years. Additional criteria for candidates from Government/CPSE background: Should be working in the equivalent IDA pay scale for at least the last 4 years (E8(a): Rs. 1,20,000-3%-2,80,000; E4/E2: Rs. 60,000-3%-1,80,000 or equivalent). Additional criteria for candidates from Private Sector: CTC should not be less than Rs. 27 Lakhs per annum for E8(a) posts, and not less than Rs. 13.62 Lakhs per annum for E4/E2 posts. Candidate should be working in a reputed organization having a minimum annual turnover of Rs. 2,500 Crore or more (average of the three audited financial years preceding the current year). Teaching experience, internship, apprenticeship, and pre-qualification experience will not be counted towards the required experience. Periods of sabbatical leave and extraordinary leave will also not be counted. Only PwBD candidates with a specified disability of not less than 40% are eligible for the applicable benefit of reservation/concession.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for SJVN Recruitment 2026 (Advt. No. 127/2026)?
faq.answer: The online application window closes on 26/08/2026 at 11:59 PM. The last date to send the application printout along with certificates to the SJVN office is 15/09/2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SJVN Advt. No. 127/2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 21 vacancies across Chief General Manager (E8), Deputy Manager (E4), and Engineer (E2) posts in Electrical, Mechanical, C&I, and Chemical disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for SJVN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 plus 18% GST. SC/ST/PwBD/ESM/EWS candidates are exempted from paying the fee.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for SJVN Engineer, Deputy Manager and CGM posts?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years for Engineer (E2), 36 years for Deputy Manager (E4), and 55 years for Chief General Manager (E8(a)), as on the closing date, with applicable age relaxation for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for SJVN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A full-time regular bachelor's degree in the relevant engineering discipline (Electrical, Mechanical, C&I related streams, or Chemical Engineering/M.Sc Chemistry) from a recognized University/Institution of India is required, depending on the post applied for.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for SJVN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process consists of scrutiny of applications, an optional qualifying screening test, document verification, and a Personal Interview. Final merit is based purely on marks secured in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary/pay scale for SJVN posts under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The IDA pay scales are Rs. 1,20,000-3%-2,80,000 for E8(a), Rs. 70,000-3%-2,00,000 for E4, and Rs. 50,000-3%-1,60,000 for E2, along with allowances and other benefits.

faq.question: Q8. Can private sector candidates apply for SJVN Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Private sector candidates can apply provided they meet the minimum CTC criteria (Rs. 27 Lakhs PA for E8(a); Rs. 13.62 Lakhs PA for E4/E2) and are working in an organization with a minimum annual turnover of Rs. 2,500 Crore.

faq.answer: Eligible candidates must apply online at www.sjvn.nic.in under the Career section, and subsequently send a printout of the application along with the required documents to the SJVN Corporate Head Quarters in Shimla by the prescribed date.
